name: MVGS_EX_METACHRONOUS_TUMOR
title: Metachronous tumour observed
description: Whether metachronous tumours were observed at a follow-up (KDK followUp.followUpOds[].metachroneDiagnoses). MII has no element for the flag (DISCUSS-TD #4): from 2027 a true flag with diagnoses is derived from follow-up Conditions carrying extension:occurredFollowing -> primary tumour; this extension keeps the flag when it cannot be derived (false, true without diagnoses, profile set 2026).
